falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 'bottom_2024_aug' pattern match (which implies a drawn-out low/volatile base), proving the signal misidentified a consolidation as a bottom and the market instead broke into a continuation rally

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX indicates complacency and risk-on stability, directly contradicting a bottoming regime that requires elevated or spiking volatility; the 78% pattern match to an August 2024-style bottom would be proven false as bottoms feature VIX >20, not <12

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.50% and holds there for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp rates breakout would signal macro stress (inflation repricing or term premium shock) rather than the rate-relief/dovish-pivot environment typical of equity bottoms; this would prove the 'bottom' call wrong as yields and stocks would likely selloff together, invalidating the bullish divergence the signal depends upon

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
